name: Whitelabel Partner
description: The full white-label test: the Whitelabel brand as a partner would run it, on its own domain (tasks.gracefultools.com), its own Vercel project (whitelabel-partner) and its own database, with agent identities on that domain. Sign-in is passkey-only until Google/Apple are registered for the domain; services that need credentials this project does not have are off, so the profile advertises only what works. Set up with scripts/push-brand-env.ts; see brands/README.md. The URL scheme stays astrid: it is part of an app's identity, and the test binaries (iOS, Mac, Windows) register only astrid://, so a partner's own scheme needs a partner-built app.
